newsitem.title: JAPAN: Salomon Bros denies talk of large Sept JGB holding.
newsitem.headline: Salomon Bros denies talk of large Sept JGB holding.

text.p: Salomon Brothers Asia Ltd on Thursday denied market speculation that the brokerage held large long open interest in the September JGB (Japanese Government Bond) contract on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) and would receive much of the cash bond delivery later this month.

"Salomon Brothers Asia Ltd denies the speculation cited in Reuters article on September 10 that Salomon Brothers Asia might receive much of the cash delivery against the September contract," it said in a statement.

Traders told Reuters on Tuesday that Salomon Brothers Asia Ltd looks likely to receive much of the cash delivery against the September contract and U.S. hedge funds could be behind the major U.S. brokerage.
A record 2.3519 trillion yen worth of the September JGB, which expired on Friday, is due for settlement through delivery of cash JGBs on September 20, the TSE said.
While an exceptionally large amount of cash JGBs are due for delivery, there is a severe shortage of the cheapest deliverable cash JGBs for the September, traders said.
